note: The OLG adequately covers all four special standards FNS 870 specifies for disabled individuals. (1) Net income only: The 'What is SNAP?' page explicitly states 'There is no gross income limit for a household that includes an elderly and/or disabled person,' and 'How SNAP Benefits are Calculated' confirms 'A SNAP household that includes at least one elderly or disabled member is not subject to a gross income test.' The 'Elderly or Disabled Clients' page also lists 'gross income standard exception' as a special regulation. (2) Excess medical deduction: Listed on 'Elderly or Disabled Clients' with link to 'Overview of Medical Expense Deduction.' (3) Uncapped shelter deduction: Listed on 'Elderly or Disabled Clients' with link to 'SNAP Annual Cost-of-Living Adjustment (COLA).' (4) Special household composition: Extensively covered on 'Separate Household Status for Elderly and Disabled' with provisions for elderly-and-disabled individuals and severely disabled individuals. Disability verification requirements are covered on 'SNAP Disability Requirements and Verifications.' Layer 1's concern that the OLG doesn't clearly state the gross income exemption is not supported — multiple OLG pages state this explicitly.
